chapter: CBS, return to Ellington and retirement
title: Colleagues and guest stars at CBS
summary: Other well-known soloists did stints there; Brown recalls Urbie Green, Godfrey and movie star guests.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Were there any other name musicians working on staff with CBS at the time you were there?
Well, there were many of them which would be recognized in certain places, but they seem to keep every man sort of equal. There weren't any terrific stars as you would call them.
In the studio I realize that.
I wondered if there was anyone like you who had been a well-known instrumental soloist who was also at that time working studio?
Oh, yes. There was plenty. There was

Irvie Green, and there was -- well, all of the big timers usually did a stint there one time or another. And, oh yes, Godfrey -- we also did the Godfrey show. Oh, many, many, many shows over a period of four years. And all of the big movie stars would do a guest appearances. You got to see everything, and experience a stint of doing a turn with all these big performers.
